noun_definition: Chat refers to the messaging interface within the application where users can send and receive text messages.
Paragraph refers to a distinct section of text that should be displayed with proper formatting, including spacing, after being copied from an HTML file into a chat.
Space refers to the gaps or intervals between text elements that are expected to be preserved when copying and pasting content from an HTML file into a chat.
Text refers to the content that is copied from an HTML file and pasted into a chat, which is expected to maintain its formatting, including paragraphs and spaces.

html file refers to a document that contains structured content in HyperText Markup Language, which is being copied and pasted into a chat but fails to retain its formatting, such as paragraphs and spaces.
